Case A: A drug-store pharmacy without the applicable complex nonsterile authority plans a preparation classified as complex under the Massachusetts policy.

Case B: The pharmacy proposes crushing hazardous tablets into a suspension using an assessment of risk previously written only for counting intact tablets.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_choice_text: Obtaining the complex license eliminates the separate need to assess hazardous-drug controls.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 면허 취득 자체가 적정 시설·훈련·노출 방지 조건을 대신하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: The formulation, personnel preparation, facilities, and hazardous-drug controls require a combined assessment.
A.finding_ko: INCORRECT이므로 진술의 참·거짓과 정답 선택을 구분했다. 복합 면허를 받았다고 제형·인력·시설·HD 노출관리 의무가 없어지지 않는다. 면허 자격과 실제 조제 관리 조건을 함께 충족해야 한다.
A.exact_authority: 247CMR6.02(3),6.07; Policy2023-07 II.A,VII.A–C; Board USP800 advisory pp1–3; 247CMR9.01(3),currentUSP unless otherwise Board-regulated

Case A: A patient's agent requests flavoring of an eligible Schedule VI medication under the described Massachusetts policy pathway.

Case B: A technician proposes using a different diluent and concentration from a kit's manufacturer-approved directions, while continuing to classify the process as unchanged manufacturer-directed reconstitution.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_choice_text: The Schedule VI flavoring permission also authorizes any formulation change to Schedule II–V medicines.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 약물 범주와 허용 행위의 조건을 다른 schedule로 확대하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Permission for the specified Schedule VI flavoring pathway should not be extended to every Schedule II–V formulation change.
A.finding_ko: 환자/대리인의 VI 향료 요청을 prescriber consultation 없이 반영하는 경로가 II–V의 임의 제형 변경을 모두 허용하지 않는다. 스케줄·변경 항목별 policy 조건을 따로 적용한다.
A.exact_authority: Policy2018-01 III.A–C.ii; Policy2023-07 II.B note,III.C

B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 허용된 Schedule VI flavoring도 dose·stability·compatibility와 변경 기록을 확인한다.

C.original_choice_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Kit 사용 여부보다 실제 제조사 지시를 그대로 지켰는지가 중요하다.
교정된 설명: The changed diluent and concentration prevent assuming that the preparation is the same approved-instructions exception.
C.finding_ko: 원래 kit를 썼다는 사실만으로 제조사 지시 준수 예외가 유지되지 않는다. 실제 희석액·농도를 변경한 준비는 unchanged-label reconstitution과 같다고 가정할 수 없다.
C.exact_authority: Policy2023-07 I.A,III.B,III.E

D.original_choice_text: Calling an activity tablet splitting settles its classification without reviewing the product.
D.original_choice_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 동작 이름만으로 nonhazardous·modified release·조제 분류를 결정하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Tablet splitting requires attention to hazardous status, release characteristics, and actual manipulation.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy has an ISO 5 primary engineering control in an unclassified segregated compounding area and proposes assigning Category 2 conditions based only on the hood classification.

Case B: A second pharmacy describes Category 3 as a drug-toxicity classification and assumes it has no relation to facilities, testing, or allowed beyond-use dates.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_choice_text: A product-protective positive-pressure workbench necessarily provides hazardous-drug containment.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 무균성 보호와 외부 HD 노출 방지는 동시에 충족해야 할 별도 목적이다.
교정된 설명: Sterile hazardous-drug work requires both product protection and appropriate containment for exposure control.
A.finding_ko: INCORRECT이므로 진술의 참·거짓과 정답 선택을 구분했다. 제품 보호용 positive-pressure workbench라는 설명만으로 HD 노출 containment가 확보됐다고 볼 수 없다. 무균 제품 보호와 작업자/환경 차폐를 함께 설계해야 한다.
A.exact_authority: Board USP800 advisory p1 containment scenarios; NIOSH2023-130 §6.2 Engineering Controls; Policy2023-07 VII.C.1–2; 247CMR9.01(3),currentUSP unless otherwise Board-regulated

Case A: Preparation of an otherwise eligible immediate-use CSP starts at 8:00 AM and finishes at 8:25 AM. Administration is planned to begin at 12:15 PM.

Case B: A separate otherwise eligible preparation combines four different sterile products, but a staff member argues that small quantities make it fit the described three-product immediate-use limit.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_choice_text: Four different sterile products satisfy the stated limit when each amount is small.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 서로 다른 sterile products의 수와 사용하는 부피·vial 수를 혼동하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Four different sterile products exceed the stated limit regardless of their small individual quantities.
A.finding_ko: 작은 양이라도 서로 다른 sterile product4개는 명시된3-product 한도를 초과한다. 부피나 같은 제품의 vial 수로 다른 product 수를 대체하지 않는다.

Case A: A medication is not federally scheduled, but its handling can expose workers to a hazardous drug. Staff propose excluding it from the pharmacy's hazardous-drug assessment solely because it has no DEA schedule.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_choice_text: An ingredient's generic name is sufficient to assess risk without its dosage form or manipulation.

선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Counting·crushing·compounding·spill에서 노출 형태가 달라진다.
교정된 설명: Dosage form, packaging, manipulation, and exposure pathways are relevant to the risk assessment.

Case A: After a hazardous-drug manipulation, an employee uses an alcohol wipe and documents that deactivation, decontamination, cleaning, and disinfection are all established by that one action.

A.original_choice_text: The described section 503B pathway remains subject to cGMP requirements.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 503A와 503B의 면제 범위·품질 규제를 동일시하지 않는다.
